privacy: Synthetic cases only. Do not infer client facts from them.

cases.title: Credit block review without a permanent queue
cases.prompt: Sales orders with a credit block wait in one review queue. Analysts spend time collecting the same order, customer and exposure context. The business wants faster release, but finance wants independent control for material credit risk.
pressure: Would you automate the release?
What changes for low-risk and high-risk orders?
cases.useful_function: Release safe orders quickly while preserving independent control for material credit risk.

system_shapes.simplify: Move exact checks and evidence collection before the analyst queue; remove reviews that do not protect an independent risk.
system_shapes.deterministic: Use risk tiers and explicit release states. Low-risk cases follow deterministic rules; material cases keep independent approval.
system_shapes.uncertainty_assisted: Use AI to summarize evidence or classify ambiguous cases. Keep credit policy, approval and execution outside model authority.

cases.authority: Read can be broad within authorization. Propose may be automated. Validation stays deterministic. Material release remains approval-bound.
red_flags: automatic release only because the model is accurate
one workflow for every risk tier
lead_signals: keeps approval independent for material risk

cases.title: Pricing logic that became a forest of exceptions
cases.prompt: A global sales template has accumulated many local pricing conditions, manual overrides and custom checks. Business units want local commercial freedom, while the program wants one supportable pricing model.
pressure: Would you centralize all pricing?
Where should local logic live?
cases.useful_function: Calculate explainable commercial prices with common controls and valid local flexibility.

system_shapes.simplify: Delete unused or duplicate conditions and overrides that do not protect a real local requirement.
system_shapes.deterministic: Keep common pricing states and policy centrally; isolate local decision tables or extension points behind explicit ownership.
system_shapes.uncertainty_assisted: Use AI only to explain price composition, detect unusual combinations or propose analysis paths, not to calculate mandatory price rules.

cases.authority: Price calculation rules and authorization remain deterministic. AI may explain or propose investigation, not own commercial approval.

experiment.counter: pricing defect or unauthorized override rate

red_flags: replacing pricing rules with an LLM
copying the full global procedure per country
treating every local request as mandatory

cases.title: Short supply: local sales priority vs global customer promise
cases.prompt: During constrained supply, each region wants to protect its own important orders. Local prioritization improves regional KPIs but can damage the global customer promise and margin.
pressure: Who owns the allocation rule?
Would you optimize it with AI?
cases.useful_function: Allocate constrained supply to the orders that create the best enterprise outcome while keeping policy explainable.

system_shapes.simplify: Remove local priority rules that duplicate enterprise policy or are never used during real shortages.
system_shapes.deterministic: Centralize stable allocation policy and allow explicit contextual parameters for valid market or customer commitments.
system_shapes.uncertainty_assisted: Use prediction or AI to estimate demand risk or summarize trade-offs, while the allocation policy and final high-impact override remain governed.

cases.authority: Enterprise policy owner defines constraints; local teams provide context; override rights and reasons are explicit.

experiment.counter: invalid local override or margin loss rate
experiment.scope: one product family during a simulated shortage

lead_signals: moves the problem to enterprise level
measures global outcome and local counter-effects

cases.title: Routine purchase approvals consume the same attention as risky ones
cases.prompt: Many purchase requests follow the same approval path although routine low-value requests are complete and predictable. Procurement wants shorter lead time without weakening spend control or segregation of duties.
pressure: Which approvals would you remove?
How do you prevent control erosion?
cases.useful_function: Approve routine procurement quickly while preserving spend control, segregation of duties and accountability.

contradiction.improve: approval lead time and touchless processing

system_shapes.simplify: Automate evidence collection and remove approvals that add no independent decision or risk reduction.
system_shapes.deterministic: Route by risk, value and rule completeness; keep explicit approval only for cases with remaining business judgment.
system_shapes.uncertainty_assisted: Use AI to read free-text justification or summarize supporting documents; never let it replace SoD or mandatory approval policy.

cases.authority: Read and propose may be automated. Exact policy validation stays deterministic. Material spend approval remains accountable.
red_flags: approval removed only to improve cycle time
SoD treated as a soft recommendation

cases.title: Global sourcing policy vs local supplier reality
cases.prompt: The company wants common sourcing rules, but plants and countries have valid local suppliers, lead times and constraints. Central rules keep growing exceptions and local teams maintain workarounds.
pressure: Would you allow local source determination?
How do you stop policy fragmentation?
cases.useful_function: Select a valid source quickly while preserving enterprise sourcing policy and local supply reality.

system_shapes.simplify: Remove global branches that merely duplicate local facts and retire local rules with no current business use.
system_shapes.deterministic: Centralize policy and eligibility; keep local source ranking or contextual rules in a governed decision layer.
system_shapes.uncertainty_assisted: Use AI to interpret unstructured supplier evidence or explain source candidates, not to bypass policy or contracts.

cases.authority: Central policy owns hard eligibility; local procurement owns contextual choice inside that boundary.

experiment.counter: policy violation or invalid local workaround rate

red_flags: one global list for every location
full local freedom with no common policy
lead_signals: separates common policy from local context

cases.title: Subcontracting visibility without turning every movement into a meeting
cases.prompt: A subcontracting process needs visibility of components, supplier stock and finished material. Teams add manual reconciliations and direct calls because they do not trust cross-company state.
pressure: Would you add another integration?
Where is the real state owner?
cases.useful_function: Keep component and supplier state trustworthy enough for procurement decisions without excessive manual reconciliation.

system_shapes.simplify: Remove duplicate status copies and reconciliations that do not feed a decision.
system_shapes.deterministic: Make authoritative states explicit and exchange business events or purpose-specific views instead of repeated broad synchronization.
system_shapes.uncertainty_assisted: Use AI to explain mismatch patterns or classify reconciliation exceptions after the state and event semantics are stable.

cases.authority: Each state has one accountable owner. Consumers may observe derived views; mutation stays with the owning process.
red_flags: new middleware as the first answer
AI used before semantics are fixed

cases.title: Ship faster or consolidate better?
cases.prompt: Sales wants deliveries created as soon as possible. Logistics wants consolidation to reduce transport cost and warehouse handling. Earlier execution improves speed but can fragment shipments.
pressure: What would you change in scheduling?
How do you avoid a permanent compromise?
cases.useful_function: Meet customer promise while keeping transport and warehouse effort economically reasonable.

system_shapes.simplify: Remove split causes that do not protect customer or logistics value.
system_shapes.deterministic: Use service-level and cutoff conditions so urgent orders release early while consolidatable orders wait within an explicit window.
system_shapes.uncertainty_assisted: Use prediction to estimate consolidation opportunity or disruption risk, but keep service rules and release authority explicit.

cases.authority: Customer promise and logistics policy define the boundary; execution follows deterministic release conditions.

experiment.counter: shipment count or transport cost per order

red_flags: AI decides shipment release with no policy

cases.title: Warehouse topology: local independence vs landscape simplicity
cases.prompt: A program must decide how tightly warehouse execution should depend on the core ERP landscape. Some sites need strong local resilience and scale; others value operational simplicity and fewer integration boundaries.
pressure: Would you standardize one topology for every warehouse?
What evidence would decide?
cases.useful_function: Run reliable warehouse execution with a supportable enterprise landscape and the right level of local independence.

contradiction.preserve: site-specific resilience, scale and operational independence

system_shapes.simplify: Avoid topology variation where warehouse requirements do not justify it.
system_shapes.deterministic: Define warehouse classes and topology criteria; standardize within each class rather than forcing one enterprise answer.
system_shapes.uncertainty_assisted: AI may help compare incident history or capacity evidence, but topology selection remains an architecture decision based on explicit criteria.

cases.authority: Enterprise architecture owns topology guardrails; site operations provide local criticality and recovery evidence.

experiment.primary: operational resilience or support effort against target

red_flags: one topology because it is strategic
lead_signals: keeps technology subordinate to system needs

cases.title: Batch traceability without slowing every movement
cases.prompt: The business needs strong batch traceability for selected products, but applying the same verification effort to every material and movement increases warehouse effort and process time.
pressure: Would you reduce traceability?
Where do you place the control?
cases.useful_function: Maintain required traceability while keeping routine warehouse flow efficient.

contradiction.preserve: warehouse speed and low manual effort

system_shapes.simplify: Apply batch controls only where product or process risk requires them; remove redundant manual checks.
system_shapes.deterministic: Use material/process conditions and automatic validation at the right transition rather than repeated review.
system_shapes.uncertainty_assisted: Use AI to interpret exception documents or explain traceability gaps, not to replace mandatory batch identity checks.

cases.authority: Mandatory batch identity and policy remain deterministic; exceptions escalate to accountable logistics or quality roles.

experiment.primary: warehouse processing time for controlled flows

lead_signals: moves checks to the right transition

cases.title: Order status: API call, event, or another copy?
cases.prompt: Several consumers need sales-order status. They poll the source frequently, which creates load and availability coupling. Not every consumer needs transaction-level real-time confirmation.
pressure: Would you replace all APIs with events?
Who owns the event semantics?
cases.useful_function: Keep consumers current enough for their decisions without unnecessary source dependency.

system_shapes.simplify: Stop reads that no decision uses and remove duplicated status copies.
system_shapes.deterministic: Use synchronous reads for immediate confirmation and stable business events for non-blocking state changes.
system_shapes.uncertainty_assisted: Use AI only to explain anomalies or interpret unstructured status context after the integration contract is stable.

cases.authority: Source process owns status semantics; consumers own reaction. Event transport does not transfer business authority.
red_flags: event named after technical table change

cases.title: Master-data freshness vs replication cost
cases.prompt: Downstream systems ask for near-real-time master-data updates, but full replication on every change creates load, duplicate state and complex failure handling. Many consumers use only a small subset of fields.
pressure: Would you replicate less data?
How do you keep consumers correct?
cases.useful_function: Provide each consumer with sufficiently fresh master data for its decisions without unnecessary replication complexity.

contradiction.preserve: low replication cost, low duplication and operational simplicity

system_shapes.simplify: Stop replicating unused attributes and remove consumers that can read on demand.
system_shapes.deterministic: Use change-based propagation, purpose-specific projections and consumer-specific freshness tiers.
system_shapes.uncertainty_assisted: Use AI for semantic mapping or anomaly explanation, not as the replication consistency mechanism.

cases.authority: Master-data owner controls authoritative change; consumers receive scoped views according to contract.

experiment.primary: replication volume and consumer data age
experiment.counter: decision error from stale or incomplete data

red_flags: real-time as default with no decision need

cases.title: Retry storms after a dependency failure
cases.prompt: When a downstream service is slow, multiple integrations retry aggressively. This improves local success probability but amplifies load, duplicates processing and makes recovery slower.
pressure: Would you simply increase retry count?
Where should backpressure live?
cases.useful_function: Recover failed integration work reliably without amplifying a downstream incident.

system_shapes.simplify: Remove overlapping retry layers and duplicate recovery mechanisms.
system_shapes.deterministic: Centralize retry/backoff policy per failure class, add idempotency, queueing and explicit dead-letter or recovery states.
system_shapes.uncertainty_assisted: Use AI to cluster failure causes or assist incident diagnosis, never to improvise retry policy in production.

cases.authority: Recovery policy belongs to the integration/platform boundary; individual clients should not independently amplify load.

experiment.primary: recovery time after controlled dependency failure

red_flags: each client chooses its own policy
lead_signals: moves from local to end-to-end view

cases.title: Duplicate business partner prevention without a slow request queue
cases.prompt: Data stewards manually review many business-partner requests because duplicate candidates and incomplete data are found late. The business wants faster creation but cannot accept identity mistakes.
pressure: Would you automate duplicate decisions?
What remains a human judgment?
cases.useful_function: Create trustworthy business partners quickly while keeping ambiguous identity decisions accountable.

contradiction.improve: creation lead time and first-pass quality

system_shapes.simplify: Move exact completeness checks earlier and remove reviews for cases that are clearly unique.
system_shapes.deterministic: Use exact validation plus candidate ranking thresholds; route only ambiguous identity cases to stewards.
system_shapes.uncertainty_assisted: Use similarity or AI to rank candidates and summarize evidence. Do not let the model own the final ambiguous identity decision.

cases.authority: Model can propose candidate matches; deterministic checks validate; steward approves ambiguous identity resolution.
lead_signals: measures both speed and duplicate quality

cases.title: Global product master vs local attributes
cases.prompt: A global product model keeps expanding with country- and business-unit-specific attributes. The central model becomes hard to govern, but local teams still need valid operational fields.
pressure: Would you put everything in one global model?
How do you prevent local extensions from diverging?
cases.useful_function: Maintain one trustworthy product identity and common semantics while allowing governed local attributes.

contradiction.preserve: valid local product detail and change speed

system_shapes.simplify: Remove attributes with no active consumer or policy use.
system_shapes.deterministic: Separate global identity/common semantics from governed local extensions with clear ownership and contracts.
system_shapes.uncertainty_assisted: Use AI to map or suggest semantic similarity between local fields, but not to create canonical definitions automatically.

cases.authority: Central data governance owns common semantics; local owners govern approved extensions inside explicit rules.

experiment.counter: semantic mismatch or local workaround rate
experiment.scope: one attribute family across two regions

cases.title: Governance workflow protects quality but creates waiting
cases.prompt: A governed master-data process sends most requests through the same review chain. Many rejections are simple completeness issues, while the real business judgment happens only in a small subset.
pressure: Which steps would you automate?
How do you prove quality does not fall?
cases.useful_function: Keep master-data quality and accountable policy decisions while reducing avoidable waiting.

contradiction.preserve: short request lead time and low manual effort

system_shapes.simplify: Shift exact completeness checks to request creation and remove review steps that make no independent decision.
system_shapes.deterministic: Route by exception/risk class and make state, owner and evidence explicit.
system_shapes.uncertainty_assisted: Use AI to interpret free-text requests or prepare evidence for the reviewer, not to own governance policy.

cases.authority: Software validates exact rules; accountable data roles decide unresolved policy or identity questions.
red_flags: remove governance because it is slow
lead_signals: analyzes what each step actually decides

cases.title: Order exception copilot without commercial write authority
cases.prompt: Sales operations wants an AI assistant to investigate blocked or unusual orders, find similar cases and propose a resolution. Direct write access would save time but create commercial risk.
pressure: Would you allow the agent to change the order?
How would you evaluate it?
cases.useful_function: Reduce exception investigation time while keeping commercial actions controlled and explainable.

system_shapes.simplify: Automate evidence collection and exact checks before adding an autonomous agent.
system_shapes.deterministic: Use rule-based routing and prepared-change objects with validation and approval.
system_shapes.uncertainty_assisted: Let a bounded agent investigate and propose. Keep authorization, validation and material execution separate.

cases.authority: Broad read can be useful; write tools remain narrow. R2 changes require prepared change, validation and approval.

experiment.primary: investigation time or accepted proposal rate
experiment.counter: unsafe proposal or post-change correction rate
experiment.scope: shadow mode on selected exception classes

cases.title: Operations agent: autonomy vs blast radius
cases.prompt: An operations agent can gather evidence across logs, metrics and systems. Giving it remediation tools could reduce recovery time, but a wrong action may affect production broadly.
pressure: Where would you stop autonomy?
What is the difference between a workflow and an agent here?
cases.useful_function: Use adaptive investigation to reduce diagnosis time without turning model reasoning into production authorization.

contradiction.preserve: production safety, trust and least privilege

system_shapes.simplify: Automate deterministic diagnostics and known remediation workflows first.
system_shapes.deterministic: Use an orchestrated runbook where next steps are known and permissions are explicit.
system_shapes.uncertainty_assisted: Use a bounded agent only for evidence-dependent investigation; let it prepare remediation, not authorize R3 execution.

cases.authority: Read, propose, validate, approve and execute are separate. R3 execution remains an accountable human or explicit high-assurance policy decision.

experiment.primary: correct diagnosis rate and time saved
experiment.counter: unsafe proposal, unnecessary tool call or missed-stop rate
experiment.scope: historical replay then live shadow mode

red_flags: workflow problem disguised as agent problem
lead_signals: distinguishes known workflow from unknown next step

cases.title: More AI context vs privacy and permission boundaries
cases.prompt: A policy assistant gives better answers when it retrieves process documents, contracts and operational notes across systems. More context improves quality but increases data exposure and permission complexity.
pressure: Would you index everything?
How do permissions survive retrieval?
cases.useful_function: Give users grounded policy answers with only the context they are allowed and need to see.

contradiction.preserve: privacy, least privilege and data minimization

system_shapes.simplify: Limit the assistant to sources that actually improve the target decisions; exclude unused sensitive corpora.
system_shapes.deterministic: Apply permission-aware retrieval, purpose-specific indexes or views, and deterministic access checks before context reaches the model.
system_shapes.uncertainty_assisted: Use the model to synthesize only the authorized retrieved evidence; treat retrieved content as untrusted data, not instructions.

cases.authority: Authorization is enforced outside model control. The model cannot expand its own data scope.

experiment.counter: unauthorized retrieval, overexposure or latency/cost rate
experiment.scope: one policy domain and role group
